ja260:1.1: For his benefit they go far,
ja260:1.3: I am the envoy to his belly,
ja260:1.4: don’t be angry, lord of cars.
ja260:2.2: they come under his (belly’s) control, young man,
ja260:2.3: I am the envoy to his belly,
ja260:2.4: don’t be angry, lord of cars.
ja260:3.1: O brahmin, to you I give these red cows,
ja260:3.2: A thousand (cows) together with their bull,
ja260:3.3: What will an envoy not give an envoy,
ja260:3.4: For we are surely an envoy to him.
